description: Return the same filtered history order as logbook_query in compact, bounded pages for agent context. Pass all relevant paths in files; paths use OR and other filters use AND. This is deterministic delivery, not relevance ranking. Repeat identical filters with every NEXT cursor until END complete when completeness matters.

cursor.description: opaque NEXT cursor from the previous page; rejects stale or changed queries

file.description: legacy single substring match against files touched

files.description: file substrings; matches events touching any supplied path

repo.description: absolute path to the git repository; defaults to the server's working directory, and must be inside it (or a root listed in LOGBOOK_MCP_ROOTS); when that directory is part of a repository (it holds files the repository tracks), the tools work on the repository's root

name: logbook_context
